title: Business Internship (Sales)
full_description_html:
Business Intern (Sales)

  • Fully remote | Full-time | 3 to 6 months
  • Stipend: ₹10,000 to ₹25,000 / month, plus a 20% sales incentive on every deal you close

About Procupy

Procupy is a procurement platform for buying teams anywhere. Companies in India, Mexico, and Singapore use it to run live reverse auctions, onboard vendors in minutes, route approvals, and manage POs to payments in one place. We are a small team, we are growing across markets, and every deal matters.

We are hiring a Business Intern to sit at the front of our sales engine. You will prospect, cold call, qualify, demo, follow up, and close, with the founders working alongside you. If you are looking for an internship where you make decks and watch from the sidelines, this is not it. If you want to learn B2B sales by actually selling, keep reading.

This is a sales role. Not a generalist business internship.

What you will do

  • Prospect (35%): Build target lists of mid-market and enterprise companies across India, Mexico, Singapore, and new markets as we expand. Find the procurement, finance, and operations decision-makers, and research their spend categories and buying triggers.
  • Outbound (30%): Make 40 to 60 calls a day, plus email and LinkedIn sequences. Get past gatekeepers, start conversations, and book meetings.
  • Qualify and demo (20%): Run discovery calls to understand how the buyer purchases today, map stakeholders, and show Procupy against their workflow. Team up with founders on larger deals.
  • Close and follow up (10%): Send proposals, chase decisions, negotiate within guardrails, and get signatures. Keep the CRM honest.
  • Learn the market (5%): Feed competitor intel, objections, and buyer language back into our scripts and ICP.

What success looks like

  • 300 to 400 outbound touches per week
  • 8 to 12 qualified meetings booked per month
  • 1 to 3 closed deals per month after a 30-day ramp, with founder support
  • 100% pipeline honesty. You can explain your numbers without hiding behind "the lead was bad"

Who you are

  • Final-year student or recent graduate. BBA, B.Com, B.Tech, MBA, or anything else if you can sell.
  • 0 to 1 year of experience. A prior sales, BD, or customer-facing internship is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Fluent in English and Hindi. Spanish is a strong bonus for our Mexico market.
  • Comfortable with cold calls. Not "willing to try." Comfortable.
  • Organised, competitive, and self-directed. You do not need someone to tell you to follow up.
  • Basic Excel or Google Sheets. Experience with HubSpot or Zoho is a bonus.
  • Available full-time for at least 3 months.

What you get

  • ₹10,000 to ₹25,000 per month stipend. The top of the band is for candidates with prior outbound or SaaS sales experience.
  • 20% sales incentive on every deal you close, paid on realisation.
  • Direct mentorship from the founders. You will see how a B2B SaaS company actually sells.
  • Real ownership from week one: your name on deals, your pipeline, your numbers.
  • Stipend review at 3 months based on performance.
  • Certificate and letter of recommendation on completion.
  • PPO for top performers.

Selection process

Application, then a 20-minute call, then a mock cold call or discovery role-play, then an offer.

In your application, tell us in 3 to 4 lines about a time you sold or persuaded someone, and why B2B sales at an early-stage startup.

Role:

  • Flirk Campus Crew is a 14-week marketing internship (12 November 2026 to 15 February 2027) around the launch of Flirk, a new personality-first dating & social app for 18+, where you meet people through personality, not photos. You work directly with the founder (IIM Lucknow; ex-Spotify, ex-Myntra).
  • You make Flirk a part of your campus: you bring in the first users, tell us what students actually think, and help design and run the campaigns that take Flirk from launch day (20 November) to Valentine’s Week.
  • Two tracks, you do both:
    • Creator: 1. You post about Flirk in your own voice - reels, stories, memes on your social; 2. You come up with marketing & brand-related ideas to grow Flirk's user base. 
    • Connector: you open doors to societies, fests, group chats and hangouts on your campus
  • Part-time and flexible: ~10 hours a week, online (virtual). Your exam weeks are protected -  tell us the dates and we plan around them.

Responsibilities:

  • Post-launch growth: once the app is live on the Play Store and App Store, convert those sign-ups into installs, bring in new users, and ideate on marketing and content ideas for growing the user base — the best ones get implemented.
  • Christmas and New Year: help conceive and run a phased marketing campaign, on campus and online through the last 3 weeks of December. Ideate & work on Christmas Merchandise.
  • Valentine’s Week: Ideate & work on Flirk's Valentine's day campaign/event and run it on campus from 7 to 14 February.
  • Throughout: a weekly check-in with the founder; a weekly campus pulse (what people say about Flirk, what confuses them, what breaks, what they like); Create & post two pieces of content around Flirk per week; App improvement suggestions & new ideas for growth.

title: Industrial Engineer Internship
full_description_html:
Department: production / Industrial Engineering

Designation: industrial Engineer

Qualification: b.Tech – Industrial Engineering / Production Engineering

Experience: fresher (0–1 Year)

Reporting To: production Head / Plant Head

Location: [company Location]

Industry: heavy Engineering / Machinery Manufacturing

Job Purpose

  • To Study and Analyze Manufacturing Processes Through Time & Motion Studies, Identify Productivity Gaps, Establish Standard Operation Times and Improve Utilization of Manpower, Machines and Resources.
  • The Industrial Engineer Will Work Closely with Production Supervisors and Shop-Floor Operators to Improve Manufacturing Productivity, Reduce Idle Time, Eliminate Unnecessary Movements and Establish Measurable Production Standards.

Key Responsibilities (kr As)

  • Time & Motion Study
    • Conduct Time Studies for Various Manufacturing Activities, Including Cutting, Drilling, Machining, Welding, Fabrication, Assembly and Material Handling.
    • Observe and Record the Time Taken by Operators for Individual Operations.
    • Break Down Manufacturing Activities Into Smaller Work Elements.
    • Identify Unnecessary Movements, Waiting Time, Idle Time and Process Bottlenecks.
    • Conduct Motion Studies to Identify Opportunities for Reducing Operator Movements and Improving Workplace Ergonomics.
    • Calculate Standard Time for Different Manufacturing Operations After Considering Performance Rating and Appropriate Allowances.
    • Prepare Time & Motion Study Reports and Recommend Improvement Actions.
  • Productivity Measurement & Improvement
    • Measure Operator-Wise and Process-Wise Productivity.
    • Compare Actual Production Against Planned Production and Established Standards.
    • Identify Productivity Losses Due to Manpower, Machine Breakdowns, Material Shortages and Process Inefficiencies.
    • Study Manpower Utilization and Identify Opportunities for Optimum Manpower Deployment.
    • Recommend Improvements to Increase Output without Compromising Quality and Safety.
    • Monitor the Effectiveness of Implemented Productivity Improvement Initiatives.
  • Manufacturing Process Analysis
    • Study the Complete Manufacturing Process of Clay Brick Manufacturing Machines.
    • Map Process Flows from Raw Material Cutting to Fabrication, Machining, Assembly and Final Testing.
    • Identify Non-Value-Added Activities and Opportunities for Process Simplification.
    • Analyze Production Cycle Time and Material Movement Between Workstations.
    • Identify Bottlenecks and Suggest Improvements in Workstation Layouts and Workflow.
    • Assist in Developing Standard Operating Procedures (so Ps) and Standardized Work Instructions.
  • Manpower & Machine Utilization
    • Study Operator-Wise Allocation and Utilization of Working Hours.
    • Monitor Machine Running Time, Idle Time and Downtime.
    • Identify Imbalances in Workload Between Different Workstations.
    • Suggest Better Allocation of Manpower and Machines.
    • Prepare Reports on Manpower Productivity and Machine Utilization.
  • Mis & Reporting
    • Prepare Daily, Weekly and Monthly Productivity Reports.
    • Develop Excel-Based Dashboards for Tracking:
      • Operation-Wise Standard Time.
      • Actual Time Taken.
      • Operator Productivity.
      • Machine Utilization.
      • Production Efficiency.
      • Idle Time and Downtime.
      • Bottleneck Operations.
    • Maintain a Database of Time & Motion Study Observations.
    • Present Findings and Improvement Recommendations to The Production Head.
  • Continuous Improvement
    • Participate in Kaizen and Lean Manufacturing Initiatives.
    • Apply Basic Lean Tools Such as 5 S, Process Mapping, 5 Why Analysis and Waste Identification.
    • Identify Opportunities to Reduce Manufacturing Cycle Time.
    • Support Implementation of Productivity Improvement Projects.
    • Follow up With Production Supervisors to Ensure Improvements Are Sustained.

Key Performance Indicators (kp Is)

  • Time & Motion Studies: completion Against Monthly Study Plan.
  • Standard Time Development: standard Time Established for Identified Operations.
  • Productivity Improvement: improvement in Output per Man-Hour.
  • Idle Time Reduction: reduction in Avoidable Operator Idle Time.
  • Machine Utilization: improvement in Productive Machine Hours.
  • Process Cycle Time: reduction in Manufacturing Cycle Time.
  • Process Documentation: completion of Process Maps and Work Instructions.
  • Mis Reporting: timely and Accurate Productivity Reports.
  • Improvement Projects: number of Improvement Initiatives Implemented.

Technical Knowledge & Skills Required

  • Basic Understanding of Industrial Engineering and Production Management.
  • Knowledge of Time Study and Motion Study Methodologies.
  • Understanding of Work Measurement and Work Sampling.
  • Knowledge of Standard Time Calculation.
  • Understanding of Manufacturing Processes Such as Fabrication, Welding, Machining and Assembly.
  • Basic Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Kaizen.
  • Understanding of Process Flow Diagrams and Workflow Analysis.
  • Good Command of Ms Excel, Including Formulas, Pivot Tables and Charts.
  • Basic Knowledge of Auto Cad Will Be an Advantage.
  • Knowledge of Power Bi Will Be an Added Advantage.

Educational Qualification

  • B.Tech in Industrial Engineering or Production Engineering (mandatory).
  • Fresh Graduates Can Apply.
  • Candidates with Academic Projects or Internships Related to Productivity Improvement, Industrial Engineering or Manufacturing Process Optimization Will Be Preferred.

Required Behavioural Competencies

  • Strong Analytical and Observation Skills.
  • Logical and Systematic Approach to Problem-Solving.
  • Good Communication and Interpersonal Skills.
  • Ability to Interact with Shop-Floor Workers and Supervisors.
  • Comfortable Spending Significant Time on The Shop Floor.
  • Attention to Detail and Accuracy in Data Collection.
  • Proactive Approach Towards Identifying Inefficiencies.
  • Willingness to Learn Manufacturing Processes.

title: B2B Marketing & Growth Associate
full_description_html:
About Crea8

"Will this product work for me?" sounds like a simple question. The skincare industry has spent decades making sure it isn’t. Most skincare content online is confusing, biased, or brand-driven. We think that's broken.

Crea8 is a skincare personalisation engine that helps D2C brands guide every user to the right products, based on what’s inside them. It combines skin profiling, ingredient-level formulation analysis, and explainable AI to deliver personalised recommendations that build trust, improve conversion, and increase customer lifetime value.

Users like what we’ve built. Brands are only beginning to discover us. Until we get in front of them, Crea8 is a product people like, not a business. Marketing must bridge that gap by showing brands how effective personalisation can improve conversion and engagement.

If you want a startup line for your CV, this is not the place. If you want to build something from scratch next to the founder, keep reading.

What you’ll accomplish

  • Outbound: Generate discovery calls with skincare brands through email, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels using existing content automation systems.
  • Inbound: Build Crea8’s visibility and credibility through content, press, and other channels that encourage brands to reach out to us.
    Partnerships and Relationships: Build relationships with people at and around target brands, create opportunities for introductions, and turn these connections into conversations.
  • Build a repeatable marketing system with clear metrics, documented learnings, and evidence of what works.

What a week can look like

  • Run email campaigns, manage the CRM pipeline, publish content, pitch relevant publications and creators, and test new channels.
  • Track what generates business opportunities, build industry relationships, and show brands how Crea8 addresses their challenges.

Who we are looking for

  • Strong communication skills matter.
  • Should be comfortable writing persuasive messages, reaching out to people you don’t know, following up, and finding better ways to get a response.
  • A willingness to question conventional marketing approaches, figure out what works for us, track results, and adjust when something isn’t working is equally important.
  • While 1 to 2 years of experience in marketing, growth, or sales is preferred, it isn’t required. If you have less experience, show us something you’ve grown or built on your own.

Employment:

Part-time from day one, with a three-month probation period.

Stipend and Progression:

₹15,000 - ₹20,000 per month for the first three months, increasing up to 100% per month from month four, on successful completion of probation. As Crea8 grows, my aim is to improve compensation based on business performance, your contribution, and what the company can sustainably support. The role includes an equity grant (0.5% - 3%), with the exact grant finalised before the offer letter. This allows you to participate in Crea8’s long-term growth.

Location: 
Bengaluru preferred. Remote work available, with one in-person day per week for Bengaluru-based candidates.

How we work

You work with me, not under me.
I value initiative and independent thinking, and I know you don’t like being micromanaged when you like your work.

We care about outcomes, but we also understand that experiments won't always succeed. What matters is that we learn from the results, communicate openly, and make better decisions over time.

Founder’s Note

I started Crea8 because people deserve better information about the skincare products they use. The industry relies heavily on marketing claims, leaving consumers unsure what to put on their skin. For brands, this means high acquisition costs, low conversion, and weak customer lifetime value.

Our consumer product has attracted 20,000+ users, with 14% purchase conversion, average sessions exceeding 20 minutes, and 3.8 products per purchasing user. Now, we’re focused on turning that traction into a sustainable business by bringing our personalisation engine to skincare brands.

I’ve taken the product as far as I can alone. You’ll help win our first brand customers and build a marketing system that eventually brings brands to us.
I’m looking for someone who wants to do more than execute tasks. You’ll have the freedom to challenge my thinking, experiment with new approaches, and build systems we can keep improving. 
Your work will directly shape how Crea8 grows.

We’re still pre-revenue, which means there’s plenty to build and learn. If you’re ambitious about your own growth and want to take ownership of something from the early stages, I’d like to hear from you.

Best,
Prabhav Agarwal
Founder, Crea8

title: QA and Product Internship
full_description_html:
Round Robin Solutions builds two live products: Safer Streets (reporting unsafe streets in Delhi NCR, with emergency help) and Bliss (practice management for therapists). We are looking for three QA and Product interns: 2 for Safer Streets and 1 for Bliss.

What you will do

  • Own one area of Safer Streets or Bliss and become the person who knows it best.
  • Test every new release of your area on Android and the web, against a checklist you help keep.
  • Write clear bug reports: the steps, what happened, what you expected, with screenshots or a screen recording.
  • Check our fixes and sign off your area before a release goes out.
  • Use the product as its real user would, and send a short weekly note on what felt slow, confusing, or broken, and what you would change.
  • Once a month, write up one improvement as a one-page spec: the problem, who it hurts, the change, and how we would know it worked. We build the good ones, credited to you.
  • You work on test apps and demo accounts only, never on real users' personal data.

What we look for

  • You notice details: a button that does nothing, a confusing word, a screen that takes too long.
  • You can explain a problem in writing so someone else can repeat it.
  • You think about who the user is and what they are trying to get done.
  • Clear, plain English, and you keep to the hours and deadlines you agree to.

Nice to have

  • An Android phone
  • Any testing done before, even on your own or a friend's project
  • An interest in product management, design, or UX
  • Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues, Notion or Google Sheets
  • Living in Delhi NCR (for Safer Streets).
  • No experience needed. Students and recent graduates are welcome.

What you get

  • Ownership of one product area, and improvements you proposed shipping under your name.
  • Feedback from our founder at least once a week on your actual work.
  • Real product work for your portfolio: bug reports, specs, and release sign-offs you can show.
  • A certificate of completion, and a letter of recommendation if you complete the internship and your work is good.

This is a remote, unpaid internship: 3 months, 10 to 15 hours a week, at times that suit you. Testing comes first (about 70% of your time); the rest is product work.

How we select

Answer the three application questions with care; we read every answer. Shortlisted applicants get a demo login for our test app: use the product for 20 minutes, then send 3 problems you hit (what you did, what happened, what you expected) and one change that would make it great for its user, and why. The best get a 30-minute call with our founder.

title: Founder’s Office Internship
full_description_html:
Are you someone who loves getting things done? You might be our person!

  • We’re looking for a Founder’s Office Intern who can help us with all the little (and sometimes not-so-little) things that go into growing a business.
  • One day, you might be reaching out to influencers. The next day, you might be making reports, following up with people, or helping us figure out our next marketing move.
  • Basically, you’ll get a little taste of marketing, business development, and operations — all while working directly with the founder. No two days have to look the same!

What will you be doing?

  • Social Media: Engage with people, interact with relevant accounts, cross-post content, and occasionally create stories or simple carousels. Don't worry, the founder handles the reels!
  • Influencer & Creator Outreach: Find influencers, reach out to potential collaborators, follow up, and help make collaborations happen.
  • Business Development: Help us connect with potential customers, collaborators, and other people who can help the business grow.
  • Operations & Reporting: Prepare reports, organise data, track tasks, and make sure things don't get lost in the famous “I'll do it later” zone.
  • Customer Feedback: Make feedback calls, collect responses, follow up on conversations, and help us understand what people think.
  • Founder’s Office Tasks: Basically, help with whatever needs to get done to move the business forward. You'll get to see how things work behind the scenes!

Who should apply?

  • Freshers, college graduates, or anyone looking to gain practical work experience.
  • Someone who is proactive, organised, curious, and comfortable figuring things out.
  • Someone who can communicate well, follow up without being reminded 17 times, and take ownership of tasks.
  • Basic knowledge of Instagram, Canva, Google Sheets, and digital marketing is a plus — but a willingness to learn matters more.
  • Women returning from a career break or anyone looking for a flexible opportunity is absolutely welcome to apply.

No fancy degree or years of experience required. Just bring your common sense, curiosity, and a little initiative!

The Work Details

  • Role: Founder’s Office Intern
  • Mode: 2 days from Office, 4 from Home
  • Stipend: ₹10k per month (Show me what you can do)
  • Duration: Minimum 3 months
  • Time Commitment: 5–6 hours a day
  • Working Days: Monday to Saturday (6 days a week)
  • Timings: Flexible, as long as the work gets done and communication stays consistent
  • Location: Bangalore-based candidates are a plus, but not a requirement.

We start the week with a call, align on weekly priorities, and then break things down into daily tasks. You'll know what needs to be done, and we'll keep each other updated along the way.

What happens after 3 months?

  • This isn't meant to be just another internship certificate for your resume.
  • Based on your performance, ownership, and fit with the business, there's an opportunity to move into a full-time Business Development role, with increased compensation.

A little disclaimer:

This role is for someone who likes getting things done, not someone who needs a reminder for every single task. You don't need to know everything on Day 1, but you should be willing to learn, take initiative, and figure things out.

If you enjoy being part of the action and want to understand how a business actually grows, this could be a great place to start!

Interested? Send your resume along with a few lines about yourself and why you'd be a good fit. Freshers are welcome!

Let's build something good together.
